technique_name: Compare the countries India and Japan in 5 sentences.
description: India is the second-most populous country in the world, with 1.3 billion people, whereas Japan has a population of around 126 million. India has a diversified economy and relies largely on agriculture and manufacturing to drive growth, whereas Japan has a more developed economy and values technological innovation.
